reviews.title: Terrible packaging, Open hardware, bent fins and radiator, Missing hardware, Used Parts
reviews.comment: The pictures speak for themselves. The packaging was subpar and didn’t even properly fit the product that was shipped. It arrived in the usual Amazon box, and inside that was the manufacturer’s packaging. I only received one LGA bracket and no AMD mounting hardware, even though the manual clearly states it should be included and the product listing says the same. I’m honestly surprised this product has such high reviews and is labeled as an Amazon Choice item. I ordered it with Prime on February 23 and just received it today. That delay, combined with the missing parts, is simply unacceptable. Save your money and look elsewhere, because it’s pretty clear Thermalright doesn’t care about quality control or making sure customers receive a complete product. After further inspection, I also noticed old thermal paste on the unit. That means I paid for a new part but clearly received a used or previously returned (RMA’d) item. I would give this 0 out of 5 stars if that were an option.
